detail.longDescription: PH4NTXM: Most Wanted. Our first major milestone is here. Most Wanted brings the work across PH4NTXM together: the identity chain, packet transformation, network protection, browser integration, and session controls. Three operational modes. Linux, Windows, and Lonewolf, each with its own profile and a shared focus on session consistency. This milestone includes the Rust/C Packet Transformation Engine with its TC/eBPF guard, dedicated Tor Browser integration for Lonewolf, and Boot Pilot for protection checks and Wi-Fi connection controls. Documentation has been revised alongside the source. The repository is freshly updated under v1.0.0. PH4NTXM remains source-distributed: inspect it, build it, test it. Thank you to everyone following the project. Reports, testing, and contributions help move it forward. This is Most Wanted. Our first major milestone, and the foundation for what comes next. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
